THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the claimant under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, challenging the award dated 27.03.2018 in MVC No.3094/2016 passed by the learned IX Addl. Small Causes and Addl. MACT, Bangalore.

entities.text: IX Addl. Small Causes and Addl. MACT, Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The claimant filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the MV Act, seeking just and proper compensation for injuries sustained on 06.12.2015 in a road traffic accident.
The Tribunal, after appreciating the evidence on record, awarded a total compensation of Rs.1,87,809/- with interest at the rate of 9% p.a. from the date of the petition until actual realization.
Taking exception to the same, this appeal is filed seeking an enhancement of compensation.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant-claimant and the learned counsel for the respondent-Insurance Company.
4.

The appellant/claimant sustained fractures to the 2nd and 3rd metatarsals, a fracture to the proximal phalanx of the 2nd to 5th toes, loss of some bone in the 4th and 5th toes, and other injuries due to the accident.
The claimant is said to have been NC: 2024:KHC:22250 working as a Quality Manager at Karle Factory and continues to work despite the disability suffered by him.

5. The appellant/claimant, having continued to work as a Quality Manager, is not entitled to compensation under the head of loss of future income. Given the nature of injuries sustained by the appellant/claimant, the compensation determined by the Tribunal is re-
assessed as follows:

In the result, the appeal is allowed-in-part.
The judgment of the Claims Tribunal is modified.
The claimant is entitled for a total compensation of Rs.2,76,809/- as against Rs.1,87,809/- awarded by the Tribunal.

7. The enhanced compensation amount of Rs.89,000/- (i.e.,Rs.2,76,809 - Rs.1,87,809) shall carry interest at the rate of NC: 2024:KHC:22250 6% per annum from the date of filing the petition till the date of realization in addition to the compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
8. The enhanced compensation to be deposited by the respondent-Insurance Company within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this judgment.
To this extent, the impugned award stands modified.
